decisions.decision: 1) O013: in the Worker's attendee-facing /api/me, return the signed-in attendee's own Zoom join_url values from session_sync (provider zoom, by day). For now only the admin attendee view at cloud/src/index.ts:502 reads them. In app/src/lib/sessions.ts:38-60, drop NEXT_PUBLIC_SEAT_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SESSION_N_URL as the source. Make the old /onboarding centre's 'Join the session live' button and its .ics read that per-attendee link at runtime. Show 'Join link not published yet' only when the attendee has no session_sync row. Coordinate with T-278, which shares lib/sessions.ts. Verify on the local stack with a test attendee: the button is enabled, the href is their own registrant link and the .ics has the same URL. 2) In AUDIT.md, set X001, X002, X003 and X051 to 'tracked in T-260', and confirm H056 is marked fixed (T-122, f7c7777). 3) Merge to main, deploy the Worker, publish the mirror, run node app/scripts/probe-details.mjs on main until 0 FAIL (T-240 owns the 3 screenshot-fill failures if they remain), then set the task to review.
decisions.why: Spec is fully defined and all of it can be built. T-223 already stores a join_url for each attendee in session_sync. The 2026-10-08 pass 2 note flagged that the attendee view does not expose it, which is a code gap. Merging, deploying and publishing to our own systems is pre-approved (orchestrator-autonomy).
